summary: Iteration 7 (UI-only room layout change) tested on preview URL. Found and fixed a BLOCKING crash: RoomPage.jsx used <Users2/> without importing it from lucide-react, so the whole room page threw 'ReferenceError: Users2 is not defined' immediately after LiveKit connect (white/error screen, no cards, no PTT) for BOTH admin and user. After adding the missing import, all requested UI behaviours verified: admin section pinned at top, user section below, non-admin viewer sees exactly 2 cards (admin + self, Charlie hidden), data-state attribute values correct (muted=rgb(200,76,76), idle=white), no page scroll (scrollHeight == innerHeight = 1080), empty states correct, host controls (grant-mic/mute/kick), recorder, device picker, recent-speakers strip (admin only) present, PTT via space bar functional. Backend regression: 7/7 pytest passed (owner/admin/user login + /api/auth/me + roles, bad-password, forgot-password, invalid reset token, unauthenticated room/info).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: missing `Users2` import from lucide-react caused ReferenceError and full room-page crash for every role (room unusable). Import added to line 4 — main agent should keep it.

integration_issues.flow: Speaking colour states (speaking-admin orange / speaking-user green) and 2.5s persistence
integration_issues.issue: Could not be exercised end-to-end: headless Chrome fake mic emits silence so LiveKit isSpeaking never became true. Verified only by code review (hex #E68A3B / #4C7D5B and 2500ms window via lastSpokeAtRef + 500ms nowTick are implemented correctly). LOGIC CONCERN: getCardState gates speakingActive on `!p.isMuted`, so in PTT mode releasing Space mutes the track instantly and the card flips to RED immediately — the 2.5s colour persistence is effectively unobservable except in Open-mic mode.

issues: User-section grid uses gridAutoRows 1fr, so a single member card stretches to ~640px tall (giant solid red block with name pinned to the bottom). Cap card max-height (or centre content) when visibleUsers <= 2.
Header status text shows 'LIVE · HOST + YOU' for the user even when the host has not joined (admin section says 'Waiting for the room host to join…') — inconsistent.

action_items: Keep the added `Users2` import in RoomPage.jsx (was a hard crash of the room page).
Decide whether speaking-colour persistence should survive the PTT mute (currently muted overrides it instantly).
Limit user-card height when only 1-2 members are visible (currently full-height red block).
Align room header status text with actual host presence.
critical_code_review_comments: RoomPage.jsx is 903 lines — split (ParticipantCard, PTTBar, RecordingControls, useLiveKitRoom hook). The 145-line IIFE inside <main> re-creates getCardState/renderCard on every 500ms tick.
nowTick interval (500ms) now runs unconditionally for the page lifetime; consider gating it on connected state.
Non-admin viewer filtering happens client-side only (users.filter(p => p.isLocal)); other participants' identities/metadata are still received from LiveKit, so this is a UI-only privacy measure.

rca_of_the_issue: RoomPage.jsx line 824 renders <Users2 /> for the user-section header but the lucide-react import list (line 4) omitted Users2, producing a ReferenceError during render right after the LiveKit room connected, which unmounted the RoomPage subtree (react error overlay, no cards/PTT). Fix: add Users2 to the lucide-react import.
